scenarios.title: Navigate browser on Run call for endpoint without parameters
given: The user is viewing the main API documentation page
An API endpoint without parameters (e.g. /stored-procedures) is displayed with a Run call button
scenarios.when: The user clicks the Run call button for the parameterless endpoint
then: The browser navigates directly to the endpoint URL (e.g. /stored-procedures)
The inline output textbox is not populated with fetched response content

scenarios.title: Navigate browser on Run call with entered parameters
given: The user is viewing the main API documentation page
An API endpoint with a parameter input field (e.g. /report/{id}) is displayed
The user enters a valid parameter value (e.g. 101) into the input field
scenarios.when: The user clicks the Run call button for that endpoint
then: The browser navigates to the URL reflecting the endpoint and entered parameter (e.g. /report/101)
The response is not displayed in the inline output textbox

scenarios.title: Navigate browser on Run call with multiple entered parameters
given: The user is viewing the main API documentation page
An API endpoint requiring multiple parameters (e.g. /random/{count}/{type}) is displayed
The user fills in all required parameter inputs (e.g. 5 and test)
scenarios.when: The user clicks the Run call button for that endpoint
then: The browser navigates to the composite URL containing all entered parameters in their respective positions (e.g. /random/5/test)
No inline output textbox update occurs on the documentation page

scenarios.title: Navigate browser with special characters in parameter values
given: The user is viewing the main API documentation page
An API endpoint with parameter inputs is displayed
The user enters parameter values containing spaces or special characters (e.g. badge alpha/1)
scenarios.when: The user clicks the Run call button for that endpoint
then: The browser navigates to the endpoint URL with the parameter values properly URL-encoded (e.g. badge%20alpha%2F1)
No inline response fetch is rendered in the output textbox

scenarios.title: Run call when endpoint parameter inputs are omitted
given: The user is viewing the main API documentation page
An API endpoint with parameter input fields is displayed
The user leaves the parameter inputs blank
scenarios.when: The user clicks the Run call button for that endpoint
then: The inline output textbox is not populated with a fetched API response
The browser does not execute an inline asynchronous fetch to display results in the output textbox

scenarios.title: Consistent navigation behavior across all endpoint Run call buttons
given: The user is viewing the main API documentation page containing multiple distinct endpoints
scenarios.when: The user clicks the Run call button on any endpoint listed on the page
then: The browser initiates navigation to the respective endpoint URL rather than an inline fetch to the response textbox
